assessment.detail: Plan separates separately authorized metadata capture, offline reconciliation, stopped preparation, actual-ID/source-policy packet review and a later separately authorized runtime attempt. Capture is not current-input acceptance and later phases remain unimplemented/unverified in V6h. Proposed future label is not reserved; no blind cutover/retry/reset recommended.

timing_boundary.capture_budget: 30 seconds measured from function entry; alarm installed only after initial offline file/CLI preflight.
timing_boundary.excluded_from_alarm: Initial file preflight and final observation persistence. This is not a whole-process 30-second wall guarantee.
timing_boundary.remaining_future_runtime_limits: If separately authorized later, existing 600-second controller includes 180 recovery; ten-second CLI and token-source checks are separate. None executed or accepted as current runtime proof.

proof.environment: VERIFIED_ENV for isolated local tests, hashes and pure source computations; UNKNOWN_ENV for current daemon state
proof.command: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 ./.venv/bin/python -B -m pytest --noconftest -c /dev/null -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_companion_v6h_restoration_plan.py
proof.negative_coverage: Fixed-input and current changed/unchanged source/tool drift, proposed consumed labels in either lane, malformed/transport/different/missing-field capture fixtures, exclusive-output refusal, raw-before-parse preservation and inert default.
proof.test_lane: Synthetic CLI file/metadata runner and disposable temporary outputs under socket/subprocess tripwires only. No actual --capture-once or native command.
proof.report_bindings: Every parent report sha256 binding independently recomputed and matched. Source maps/consumers and exact accepted deltas independently compared to prior fixed tables.

limitations: Current original state, start timestamps, configuration continuity, image availability, installed files, SDK/import/callable behavior, namespace/recipients, health/connectivity and successful cited request remain UNVERIFIED. Historical raw/source/image constraints are not current observations.
Source-only acceptance does not authorize metadata capture. Exactly bounded capture still needs explicit separate permission, preservation of failures and later actual-input review.
Equal selected-field capture results would be provisional evidence only, not atomic/continuous-state or post-capture guarantee. Missing/fallback metadata cannot be promoted to accepted baseline.
Default behavior and synthetic wrapper proof do not establish daemon reachability or actual command timing. Alarm exclusions are explicit and retained; no whole-process time guarantee.

Local marker checks are advisory/non-atomic and cannot substitute for future authoritative reservation/preflight. V6g consumed attempts and removed staged IDs remain historical and cannot be reused/reset.
Old packets/SDK provenance are not relabelled as fresh or operationally approved. Later packet/handoff/application policy applicability requires its own current bindings and review.
No broad SDK/repo audit or diagnosis of prior V6g first failed predicate undertaken. Existing fail-closed evidence requirements and diagnostics contract remain intact.
Only this independent_review.json written. Source/tests/JSON/checkpoint/worklog/prior records unchanged; no actual baseline, replacement or runtime packet created.
